sportsdataverse 0.3.0
text: Trimmed meta-package dependencies mirror nflverse model: package now imports cli, crayon, magrittr, rlang, rstudioapi alongside core SportsDataverse packages. sportsdataverse_deps() sportsdataverse_update() rewritten base R, dropping dplyr, purrr, tibble imports. sportsdataverse_update() gained devel argument points SportsDataverse r-universe (https://sportsdataverse.r-universe.dev) prebuilt development binaries, now reports via cli. Bumped minimum R version 4.1.0 added Config/testthat/edition: 3. Updated core package roster reflect current CRAN-published SportsDataverse R packages. Added cfbseedR (college football season playoff-seeding simulation) mlbplotR (MLB logos, headshots, plot themes) core roster; library(sportsdataverse) now attaches . Bumped minimum versions imported packages current CRAN releases: baseballr (>= 2.0.0), cfbfastR (>= 3.0.0), cfbseedR (>= 0.2.0), fastRhockey (>= 1.0.0), hoopR (>= 3.1.0), mlbplotR (>= 1.2.0), oddsapiR (>= 1.0.1), sportyR (>= 2.2.3), wehoop (>= 3.0.0). get_core_functions() now returns package’s single roster vector instead separately maintained copy. Fixed sportsdataverse_deps() leaving member packages (listed dependencies), sportsdataverse_update() never flagged --date member “Core packages” section sportsdataverse_sitrep() always empty. GitHub Actions: workflows moved actions/checkout@v6 (Node 24 runtime), gained explicit permissions concurrency groups, R CMD check now also runs macOS. pkgdown build moved pinned Ubuntu 22.04 image ubuntu-latest Posit Public Package Manager binaries, dependency list trimmed pkgdown plus package . Removed worldfootballR SportsDataverse roster (upstream repository archived). Dropped already-commented archived packages (chessR, hockeyR, toRvik) README package roster. Switched README installation instructions pacman pak. Pointed URL/BugReports sportsdataverse GitHub organization added pkgdown site (https://r.sportsdataverse.org).
